proposal.reason: Main change is a substantive NET/IB backend update in network: connection metadata/handshake and ready synchronization, QP RTR/RTS setup with ECE negotiation, GID/FLID routing and traffic-class controls, receive-size reporting semantics, and per-device MR registration cache/resource lifecycle. It also makes independent GIN-specific IB path changes (GIN connect/accept/cancel and listen-close cleanup behavior), so gin review is additionally required.
